implementation.upgrade: provider-neutral memory-read admission filters quarantined, stale, out-of-scope, under-verified, and generation-mismatched memory before execution contexts receive it; audit contexts receive data-only evidence projections

research_inputs.finding: The systematic memory-poisoning study identifies persistent long-term memory as a cross-session attack surface, multiple write channels, structural vulnerabilities, and incomplete coverage from ordinary prompt-injection defenses.
research_inputs.used_for: retrieval-time provenance, trust, verification, generation, expiry, and quarantine filtering

research_inputs.finding: Anthropic describes context as finite and recommends iterative curation of instructions, tools, external data, and history, selecting the smallest high-signal context and separating data from instructions.
research_inputs.used_for: bounded context budgets and deterministic data-only projection framing

research_inputs.finding: Microsoft documents MCP tool-description poisoning and recommends allowlists, metadata review, least agency, human approval, and correlated telemetry.
research_inputs.used_for: tool and metadata provenance labels and instruction-authority suppression

research_inputs.finding: OpenAI treats screenshots, page text, tool outputs, documents, emails, chats, and third-party content as untrusted input and recommends isolated environments and human oversight for high-impact actions.
research_inputs.used_for: browser and observation memory exclusion from execution context

limitations: The gate filters and frames memory metadata but does not itself persist, replicate, rank semantically, or retrieve from a database.
Source identity, trust, verification, and digests are caller-supplied and are not hardware-attested or independently signed by this local implementation.
The data-only projection intentionally emits digests and provenance metadata rather than raw memory content; a separate trusted content fetcher must preserve the same policy and digest bindings.
The contract does not detect every natural-language injection pattern; upstream observation, tool, and memory-write validators remain required.
The benchmark measures local Python control-plane overhead and excludes storage, network, model, accelerator, and kernel latency.
This evidence does not claim AGI, production approval, physical hardware qualification, independent builder qualification, or independent external review.
